description.value: Ex Nihilo Vineyards is a boutique estate winery in Lake Country whose name—Latin for 'out of nothing'—reflects its artisan philosophy of crafting wines from the ground up in the Okanagan. The property houses a tasting room open seven days a week alongside Chaos Bistro, an evening restaurant that regularly features live music and al fresco dining under the Okanagan sky. Cycling visitors exploring the Okanagan wine country will find it a polished destination stop with walk-in tastings available as well as reservable guided experiences.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (1525 Camp Road, Lake Country, BC V4V 1K1) and phone number (250-766-5522), and the tasting room and Chaos Bistro are clearly active, making confirmed_open true. No mention of bike racks, bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, device charging, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all such fields default to null. The wine shop sells bottles in-store, but no food takeout or packed lunch service is described, leaving those null as well.
concerns: No bike parking, washroom access, or any cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website; direct contact or an on-site visit is needed to confirm the required WWC criteria before finalizing the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Ex Nihilo Vineyards is an active, well-established winery with a tasting room and full-service bistro sitting directly on the Okanagan wine route corridor—a clear destination-stop fit for the WWC cycling tourism directory.
